meaning.en: (linguistics) Of or relating to morphemics or to a morpheme.
meaning.vi: (ngôn ngữ học) Có hoặc liên quan đến morphemics hoặc morpheme.

sentences.en: By a specific process, high quality calcium stearate was prepared by reaction of calcium hydroxide with stearic acid in water under morphemic pressure.
